law_name: Law on Protection of Personal Data (HO-49-N)
jurisdiction: Personal Data Protection Agency (Ministry of Justice)
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, notify Agency of biometric or special-category processing
data_categories: Personal data; special category data; biometric data
retention_period: Art. 5(5): stored so as to exclude identification beyond period needed for purposes; Art. 9(2): consent-based data kept for period necessary or set in consent
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Agency of the Ministry of Justice
notes: Replaced 2002 law; EU-backed reform to align with GDPR is being drafted
